reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but the daily-skip-vs-move weekend rule is written again instead of being factored into a function shared with getUpcomingDates/getNextDate.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily'` skip-or-move dispatch is a fresh copy of the one in getUpcomingDates (and shared getNextDate / schedule-template getEffectiveDate), now a fourth copy of the same rule.

placement.why: Lives as a handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates, which is where the tree puts these date handlers, though the weekend rule itself belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and self-contained, but any change to weekend handling must now be repeated in one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared adjust-occurrence abstraction exists; it does call the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the move case.

disguised_duplication.where: schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: the daily-skip/else-move dispatch from getUpcomingDates is reshaped into an if/continue/else-if inside the loop rather than shared
